{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
A '''brigade''' was a type of military formation that was used by the [[Imperial soldier]]s of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] later<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="GentleGiant">{{GentleGiantCite|set=Premier Collection Statues|pack=Hawkbat Battalion Clone Trooper|altlink=https://www.ebay.com/itm/144118552545}}</ref> and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Dark Times 1">[[Dark Times 1|''Dark Times'' 1]]</ref> In the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], an example of a brigade was the [[3rd Brigade]]. The 3rd Brigade's [[Hawkbat Battalion]] participated in many battles during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="GentleGiant" /> Early during the Clone Wars, the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] had at least three brigades, of which [[Carnivore Battalion/Legends|Carnivore Battalion]] and [[Execute Battalion/Legends|Execute Battalion]] were a part of. During the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], [[Jedi Gate Master]] [[Jurokk]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] estimated the force from the 501st Legion that stormed the Temple as numbering several brigades in strength.<ref name="ROTS Novel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>

After the [[Declaration of a New Order]] and the Republic transforming into the Galactic Empire, a [[Unidentified brigade (501st Legion)|brigade]] of the 501st Legion was deployed to [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]] to defeat the local [[New Plympto resistance (Imperial Period)|resistance]].<ref name="Dark Times 1" /> The brigade was composed of a [[Vill's regiment|regiment]] under the leadership of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Vill]].<ref name="Dark Times 2">[[Dark Times 2|''Dark Times'' 2]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Brigade was used in the [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], which released in [[2005]].<ref name="ROTS Novel" />
